notes: v623 — THE DUPLICATE-TRADE CLEANUP, MADE MORE ROBUST. If yesterday's tool said 'no duplicates found' while you could still see them sitting there, here's why: it was matching on EVERY field, including ones computed from the trade rather than defining it — and those can carry tiny, invisible sub-cent differences that never show up once rounded on screen, but were enough to make true duplicates look different to an exact check. It now matches on what actually identifies a trade — ticker, exchange, dates, quantity, prices — and ignores the arithmetic that flows from those. If it still can't find an exact match, it now shows every field for same-ticker, same-day trades side by side, so there's something concrete to go on instead of a dead end. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) and try the cleanup again.
